revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: 2026-11-23 mouse release state: handleMouseUp snapshots the remaining physical mouse-button mask plus Ctrl/Shift via the existing nonmutating peekKeyDownState accessor after removing the released button. Existing queued, captured, direct-control and dialog release calls receive that wParam. No new callback, guest entry, timer, continuation, retained reference or invocation ownership; release cleanup, DirectInput edges, coordinates, capture routing and synchronous versus queued delivery stay in their existing order. Native EDIT can return before legacy modifier flags update, and queued key-up delivery must not override current physical state. NEW test-renderer-mouse-up-modifiers.cjs covers 254 release cases; unchanged drag, capture, modal and browser-key regressions pass. Ownership remains pending.
